dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY statements with .INC and no-extension copybooks typical of ORCA system.

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) software - payment/receipt list management screen (S02 component handling patient billing, insurance claims, and payment collection)
purpose.summary: ORCGS02 is a screen program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that manages a payment/receipt list (seikyu ichiran). It handles patient billing records, insurance combinations, inpatient/outpatient classification, and payment status display and editing. The program supports recalculation, re-issuance of receipts, and various insurance-related processing.

notable_features: 59 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
381 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
Japanese comments encoded in EUC-JP/latin-1 (garbled in ASCII view)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary ORCA middleware
Extensive revision history with version tracking from 2000-2008
verdict.notes: Source file is 6390 lines, decoded as latin-1 but contains Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments which appear garbled. This is the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) system, a well-known open-source Japanese medical billing system. The program_type is listed as online-cics but actually uses ORCA's own screen/middleware framework rather than CICS. Fixed format with a few lines slightly over 72 chars (15 long lines).
